headline: The burn mechanism has been announced — but not published as a specification.
message: Paul Sztorc described the pECX redemption burn in the Drivechain Talk Telegram group on 14 September 2026: send the pECX to the Bitcoin eater address in a transaction that also carries a 0-valued OP_RETURN naming an address you control, and send more than the 1,000 pECX threshold. It is a chat answer, not a document — no official specification page exists for it yet, and wallet support is still being written.

expect.ratio: 1,000 pECX = 10 ECX (100:1) — stated earlier, not in this announcement
expect.note: Balances may not carry over from alpha to beta.

announcement.source_note: Drivechain Talk (Telegram, private supergroup) — Paul Sztorc, 14 Sep 2026 01:22 UTC, confirmed by him at 01:25 UTC ("Yes that's the one"). Message ids 250407, 250411, 250412, from the group export of 14 September 2026.
announcement.quote: 1. Send to 1BitcoinEaterDontSendxxx  2. Add a 0-valued op return, to an address A that you have the key for. The coins will go to address A. As long as there is more than the threshold (1000).

published_override.reason: Hand-published on the owner's instruction from the Telegram export of Drivechain Talk. The source is the project lead in the project's own group, not an official-domain document, so the automated allowlist would refuse it.

spec.network: pECX on the ECX alpha chain
spec.payout: ECX to the address carried in the 0-valued OP_RETURN
spec.deadline: Not stated in the announcement — burn before ECX mainnet
spec.source_note: Telegram: Drivechain Talk, 14 Sep 2026. No official document or web page for this exists yet.

guide.title: Confirm you hold more than the threshold
guide.detail: The burn only counts above 1,000 pECX. A balance just over the threshold qualifies, but do not burn more than you would accept losing.

guide.title: Build a transaction with only two outputs
guide.detail: Paul: "Better if the txn has only two outputs" — the payment to the burner, and the OP_RETURN. Nothing else.

guide.title: Send the pECX to the burn address
guide.detail: The standard Bitcoin eater address: valid base58, and 5,640 transactions have gone into it on BTC with zero ever spent out.

guide.title: Put a 0-valued OP_RETURN in it, naming an address you control
guide.detail: That address is where the ECX will be paid at mainnet, so it must be one you hold the key for. This is the part to get exactly right.

guide.title: Keep the txid
guide.detail: It is the proof of the burn, the thing tooling will read, and your tax record.

guide.title: Wait for the tooling
guide.detail: Paul said he will add this to BitWindow, "probably under the redeem investor code part". No released wallet has a button for it yet, so a hand-built transaction is currently the only route.

warnings: Burning is irreversible. The eater address has no private key by design — those pECX are gone.
The payout address goes inside the OP_RETURN. Get it wrong and the ECX is paid to a key you do not control.
This came out of a Telegram chat, not a published specification. There is no official document, no wallet support, and the terms could still change.
The conversion ratio is NOT in this announcement. Earlier statements put it at 100:1 (1,000 pECX = 10 ECX) — ask before burning anything you would miss.
Alpha and beta balances may not carry over. Make sure you are burning the pECX you mean to, on the right stage of the fork.
Nobody legitimate needs your seed phrase or private key to help you redeem. Anyone who asks is robbing you.
